# Step laws and endpoint traces

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`trace-law-equivalence` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](trace-law-equivalence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Two processes on the same configurations and moves take the same steps exactly when they have the same finite traces with both endpoints kept; traces of one move suffice. Feasible words alone lose the law.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Two processes on the same configurations and moves take the same steps exactly when they have the same finite traces, both endpoints kept, from every configuration; a trace of one move is exactly a step, so traces of one move suffice. (`Becoming.same_steps_iff_traces`, `Generative.trace_singleton_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Forgetting endpoints loses the law: on two configurations with one move, static keeps the configuration and toggle flips it; they take the same words from every configuration, static goes from false to false in one move and toggle does not, so they do not take the same steps. (`Becoming.Carriers.static`, `Becoming.Carriers.toggle`, `Becoming.Carriers.word_feasibility_does_not_determine_endpoints`, `Becoming.Carriers.static_toggle_not_same_steps`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Two supplied processes on one type of configurations and one type of moves, of any kind, with no premise on either; traces are the finite traces of the core's foundation, every intermediate configuration carried.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- **Counterexample:** Word feasibility alone loses law information; static and toggle processes supply the counterexample. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Carriers.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## Next
